family: Active Directory ACL, tiering, honeytoken, replication, certificate, graph, trust, and assessment assurance

selection.reason: These ten skills share bounded Active Directory policy, ACL, graph, certificate, and structured audit-event inputs. Static predicates are proposed only where deterministic; BloodHound, LDAP/domain, SIEM/EDR, trust/runtime, and specialist assessment authorities remain blocked external engines.
